The purest essence of a katana. No add-ons, no modifications — only razor-sharp corporate steel.

Category: Super Luxury • Fabrication: N/A (Cannot be Fabricated. Must be gifted or scavenged from Sandayu Oda. So, good luck with that)

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Melee • Skill: Melee • Range: Melee

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: N/A • ROF: 2 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: None • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: This weapon’s second attack in a Round against the same target deals 1d6 extra damage (4d6), as long as the first attack hits. When performing an Ambush Attack from stealth, this weapon provides an additional +1 bonus to the Attack Check and its first Attack in that Round deals 1d6 additional damage (4d6) if successful.

If the user has active FBC Chameleon Coating and/or Optical Camo and is rolling for damage with this weapon, 5s count as 6s for the purposes of incurring Critical Injuries. Whenever this weapon’s user is actively using FBC Chameleon Coating or Optical Camo and has moved at least 2m/yds (1 square) this Turn, they can make a Leaping Strike attack that sends the user 4m/yds (2 squares) forward to attack a target with fierce speed. This takes up half of the weapon’s ROF 2, does not consume MOVE, and deals 1d6 additional damage (4d6) if successful.

Whenever this weapon’s user has active Speedware and spends at least one LUCK on an Attack with this weapon, they add an additional +1 to their Check.

Fabrication: N/A (Cannot be Fabricated. Must be gifted or scavenged from Sandayu Oda. So, good luck with that)
Range: Melee

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
